judgment.notes: Compared the complete inspected type with H001–H004 and D004–D006,D012,D013 in source-context.json and the original hypotheses. Natural l parametrizes exactly the integers λ≥0, with l<p. Complex-linear x,y,h with the three displayed relations encode the sl₂ representation; finite dimension l+1, invariant-subspace irreducibility and the nonzero highest vector encode the stated highest-weight module. No condition v∈M is added. The integer submodule M is exactly an additive subgroup; the two bases in H004 have identical included vectors, and stability under every divided power is equivalent to stability under the generated integer algebra. M remains arbitrary. In Proof.lean:14–31, Lift has only a restriction map and its pointwise agreement, and Actions adds restrictions of the three generators and divided powers, not an irreducibility premise. These restrictions are constructed at 1035–1046; agreement and injectivity of M→V make their maps unique. Thus existential Actions does not weaken the conclusion. VK=K⊗ℤM has the same K-vector space and induced action as M⊗ℤK under the canonical flip; this is a semantic identification, not an unimplemented conversion used between two Lean models. Actual localization/residue conversions and intertwining are provided at 440–461,1078–1136,1196–1245. Nontrivial and the universally quantified K-submodule bottom/top alternative supply both target clauses for the actual induced x,y,h. There is no algebraic-closure, positive-l, p>2 or distinct-reduced-weight premise: l=0 and p=2 remain included. The abstract rank-three Chevalley algebra acts through these generators, so invariance under its span is exactly the displayed three invariances, even for a nonfaithful action.
